_comment: Live config for Duckdoku Blast. Copy this file into the jvea03/duckdoku-privacy repo as config.json; it is then served at https://jvea03.github.io/duckdoku-privacy/config.json, which is RemoteConfig.CONFIG_URL. Every value below is the shipped default, so publishing it as-is changes nothing: edit a number, commit, and players pick it up at their next launch (and after an hour away). Only keys in Tunables.DEFAULTS are accepted, with the right type and within 0 to 20x the default; anything else is ignored and a broken file changes nothing.

inbox.title: New weekly quests are on the way!
inbox.body: A fresh set of weekly quests arrives when the new week starts: Monday 00:00 UTC (Sunday afternoon in the Americas). Until then, last week's unfinished quests still count, and everything you collect goes into your Thanksgiving Pass!

inbox.title: Leaderboards are live!
inbox.body: Win levels to earn anchors and climb the daily, weekly and season boards. The top 3 win coin prizes! Here are 200 coins to get you started.

inbox.title: Sorry about the leaderboards!
inbox.body: Thanks for playing in our first leaderboard week! Some players ended up on a different daily board because of their time zone, so they couldn't see each other. This update fixes that: everyone now shares the same boards, and they all reset at the same moment worldwide. Here's a little something for your patience.

inbox.title: Thanks for joining the launch!
inbox.body: Thank you for playing Duckdoku Blast in its very first weeks! This update is packed with improvements: volume sliders, profile stats, new sounds, smoother screens and more. The Thanksgiving Pass is a one-time mini pass: 20 tiers in just two weeks, with the Cornucopia Ship and a Thanksgiving sticker. Here are 10 golden ducks, enough to unlock its Premium track for free!

inbox.title: Happy Thanksgiving! 2× anchors all weekend
inbox.body: From Thursday to Sunday, every win pays 2× anchors: climb your Thanksgiving Pass and the leaderboards twice as fast! Join the World Duck Hunt too: find ducks with players everywhere to unlock the Turkey Duck! The Thanksgiving Feast is on through Cyber Monday: 130,000 coins and 10 of every booster for $4.99. Here's a free Bomb to start your weekend!

inbox.title: Day 1 of Christmas: a duck in a pear tree
inbox.body: On the first day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... a duck in a pear tree! A new gift waits here every day until Christmas. Here are 1,000 coins to start.

inbox.title: Day 2 of Christmas: two turtle ducks
inbox.body: On the second day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... two turtle ducks! They brought you 2 Sonar to find those hidden ships.

inbox.title: Day 3 of Christmas: three French hens
inbox.body: On the third day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... three French hens! (They said they were ducks. We let it slide.) Here are 3,000 coins.

inbox.title: Day 4 of Christmas: four quacking birds
inbox.body: On the fourth day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... four quacking birds! They're very loud, so they brought 2 Bombs to match.

inbox.title: Day 5 of Christmas: FIVE GOLDEN COINS!
inbox.body: On the fifth day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... five golden coins! Well, five thousand of them. Sing it with us!

inbox.title: Day 6 of Christmas: six ducks a-laying
inbox.body: On the sixth day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... six ducks a-laying! Their eggs hatched into 6,000 coins.

inbox.title: Day 7 of Christmas: seven ducks a-swimming
inbox.body: On the seventh day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... seven ducks a-swimming! They made such a splash it turned into 2 Tidal Waves.

inbox.title: Day 8 of Christmas: eight sailors sailing
inbox.body: On the eighth day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... eight sailors sailing! They found 8,000 coins in the hold.

inbox.title: Day 9 of Christmas: nine ducks dancing
inbox.body: On the ninth day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... nine ducks dancing! They danced right past the fleet and left you 3 Sonar.

inbox.title: Day 10 of Christmas: ten captains leaping
inbox.body: On the tenth day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... ten captains leaping! Santa's Sack is in the shop on Home today, and here are 10,000 coins.

inbox.title: Day 11 of Christmas: eleven bombs a-booming
inbox.body: On the eleventh day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... eleven bombs a-booming! Okay, three. Eleven was too loud. Have a booming Christmas Eve!

inbox.title: Day 12: Merry Christmas from the crew!
inbox.body: On the twelfth day of Christmas, the Duckdoku crew gave to me... twelve ships a-sinking! Thank you for playing with us this year. Here are 12,000 coins and one of every booster. Merry Christmas!

inbox.title: Happy Thanksgiving!
inbox.body: The Duckdoku crew is grateful for you. Here's 5,000 coins for your feast — go hunt some duck-ships!

inbox.title: Black Friday treat!
inbox.body: The shop's buzzing, and so is the pond. Here's 5,000 coins from the crew — a little something for your collection.

inbox.title: Cyber Monday boost!
inbox.body: One last gift from the crew: 5 Sonar, 5 Bombs, and 5 Tidal Waves. Go make some splashes!
